newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two Colombian cabinet ministers said to resign.
newsitem.headline: Two Colombian cabinet ministers said to resign.

text.p: Two cabinet ministers resigned on Friday in the latest of several expected changes in the 15-member cabinet of President Ernesto Samper, national radio reports said.
The Caracol radio news network said Foreign Trade Minister Morris Harf and Labour Minister Orlando Obregon had stepped down.

Obregon, a former labour leader who had held the post since 1995, announced his resignation in an interview the Radionet news programme. But Harf's reported decision to leave the government could not be immediately confirmed.

Obregon's prestige was badly damaged earlier this year, when union bosses branded him a traitor for defending government plans to hold public sector workers to a weighted 13.5 percent pay hike despite inflation of 21.6 percent last year.
The government wound up agreeing to pay raises of as much as 20 percent after a week-old strike in February that threatened to erupt in mass street protests.
Government sources have said at least two other cabinet officials are expected to resign, perhaps as early as next week.
